decisions.lean: A concentrated, defense-tilted expression of the firm's best-rated ideas, matched to an honest read of the tape. The Q1 Goldilocks label sits over validated planes that are defensive (growth-scare rotation, Euphoric froth with leaders distributing, risk-off breadth, elevated crash-risk) — the same read as the ROTATE_DEFENSIVE shadow posture. So I lead with the firm's two 94/100 defensives, XLV (also the #2 RS sector and only top-RS name with rising 20d momentum) and USMV (min-vol factor), add XLE as Flagship's single highest-conviction LIVE name (+0.50 confluence, energy/inflation hedge), and keep one measured tech anchor in AAPL. ~52% invested / ~48% cash — more concentrated than Flagship's 22% gross per my press-the-winners mandate, but still respectful of a fragile, distributing tape and my negative recent track record (which says lean on the highest-rated names and don't oversize any single bet). Weights sit in a tight 10–16% band, largest on the best-rated-and-RS-confirmed idea (XLV). Exited XLF: Flagship hard-vetoed it today (cycle_blocked) and its sector RS is weak (39th pctile).

That, plus the in-house read — clean risk-off (7 of 8 RoRo legs off), Q3 Stagflation with PBoC liquidity CONTRACTING, and a ROTATE_DEFENSIVE shadow posture (offense budget 0.43) — tells me to REVERSE the queued "lean back in" target, not press it. I am cutting gross from ~57% invested to ~45% (55% cash), keeping only the confirmed regime-leadership defensive complex: pharma/healthcare (the strongest 20d-momentum theme: Innovative Drugs +16.3%, Healthcare +11.1%), one staple, and one inflation hedge (coal, above its 200d trend). I EXIT the pharma laggard 珍宝岛 (down 4% with no confirmation) and I do NOT add to the utility 国电电力 — the desk just downgraded 600795 to 'avoid / cycle_blocked, extended, wait for a pullback' (conviction 4), directly contradicting last cycle's full-entry green light. Holding a large cash buffer protects CNY NAV against a falling FXI on a day the whole region is selling off; I can redeploy on confirmation once the tape stabilizes or PBoC easing actually reaches interbank rates.
decisions.thesis: EXITED 珍宝岛 (603567.SS) in full — a pharma laggard down 4% on the book with no confirmation and no rationale carried; in a clean risk-off tape you cut the non-confirmer to raise cash. Across the book I cut gross from ~57% to ~45% invested (cash ~55%), overriding last cycle's queued 'add coal/utility/API' plan because the overnight Asia selloff and the utility's fresh 'avoid' downgrade argue for de-risking, not leaning in. No adds initiated — this is not the tape to start new positions.
